name: Junya Enoki
biography: Junya Enoki is a Japanese voice actor affiliated with Atomic Monkey. His hobbies are boxing and kendo. Enoki became interested in acting while in college after watching the anime Gurren Lagann. He's a cousin of Chika Anzai.
